children: By Staff Writer

Leading developer H&H and Global Partners have announced the launch of its nature-led residential community - Eden House The Park - along the Dubai Water Canal with its park-led masterplan, car-free green core and hospitality-inspired services.

Designed around the principles of privacy, walkability and holistic wellbeing, the development offers a distinct residential experience where refined architecture and rich landscape design merge seamlessly with daily life.

It boasts 459 residences across seven distinct buildings, ranging from studios and one- to four-bedroom apartments to expansive family residences and exclusive penthouses, said the developer in a statement.
The premium project, which is owned by Global Partners, is set for completion in September next year.
H&H said that rather than placing residents within a conventional high-density urban block, Eden House The Park puts the park at the centre of the experience.

Seven low-rise buildings are woven into a landscaped setting, with homes opening onto greenery, shaded outdoor spaces and views across the canal and Dubai skyline. Located at the former Al Safa Park, Eden House The Park is bringing this beloved green space back to life, reinterpreting the historical geography of the site and drawing on its memory across the water to create a residential environment where nature is part of everyday life, stated the developer.
Select top-floor penthouses offer ultimate privacy, featuring dedicated direct lift access, allowing residents to step directly into private foyers without shared corridors, it added.

On the new project CEO Miltos Bosinis said: "Eden House The Park represents a meaningful evolution for the brand. As urban residents seek greater privacy, a stronger connection to nature and a sense of belonging, we wanted to create a community where those qualities are part of everyday life."
"By grounding the community in nature and architectural integrity, we are offering a new refined perspective on urban living in Dubai," he added.

Led by dxb lab, the architecture adopts a natural modernist approach. Dark oxidised metal, warm wood, polished concrete, textured sandy plaster, honed limestone, and aggregate terrazzo stone create a tactile material palette engineered to age gracefully. The deliberate spacing of the structures maximises natural airflow, creates shaded canopies, and frames open views toward the canal, the green core, and the Dubai skyline.
The landscape design, developed by WAHO, draws direct inspiration from the native flora and ecological character of Al Safa Park.

Drought-tolerant, layered planting and tiered stone steps manage the site's natural topography, establishing a fluid indoor-outdoor connection that turns the surrounding gardens into an organic extension of the home.

The interiors, curated by H&H Interior Design, bring together organic textures, warm tones and natural materials to create a refined and welcoming residential environment. Ground-floor lobbies welcome residents with decorative panelling, sculptural furnishings, and green fusion marble. Inside the residences, open-grained oak and ash veneers pair with nickel ironmongery, marble kitchen backsplashes, and bronze metal accents.

Bader Hareb, Managing Partner, Global Partners, said: "Eden House The Park responds to the evolving expectations of Dubai’s premium residential market, where residents are increasingly seeking space, greenery, privacy and a stronger sense of community. Its low-density, park-led approach offers a rare proposition close to the heart of the city, reflecting Dubai’s growing focus on quality of life and long-term liveability."

Residents will get to enjoy dedicated 24-hour security, valet, maintenance support, and a vacant home care programme, alongside optional personalised services such as in-home butlers, private chefs, wellness treatments, and chauffeur services.
Wellness and lifestyle amenities are thoughtfully distributed across the masterplan to maintain a low-density, peaceful atmosphere, he added.

Facilities include swimming and plunge pools, two padel courts, full fitness suites, movement studios, male and female saunas, steam rooms, spa treatment rooms, and a shared co-working space. Dedicated children’s indoor playrooms, outdoor playgrounds and swimming pools, as well as retail offering alongside direct access to the 6.4-kilometre Dubai Water Canal promenade further enrich the community's active lifestyle.
"A home extends beyond four walls - it encompasses the mood, the movement, and the subtle textures of the broader community," remarked Bosinos.
"Eden House The Park is designed to nurture a true sense of belonging through considered architecture, intuitive hospitality, and spaces that make everyday life feel effortless," he added.
